# Project Instructions

## Project
MyCravings is a React + TypeScript + Vite food-ordering simulation. Keep wallet, cart, order receipt, and payment gags in the browser; do not add a database, Supabase, or real payment or delivery integrations.

## Checklist
- [x] Requirements clarified from the project brief.
- [x] Scaffolded the Vite React TypeScript app.
- [x] Implemented the browsing and checkout experience.
- [x] No additional VS Code extensions are required.
- [x] Production build and lint checks completed.
- [x] Development server started by the scaffold command.
- [x] README and workspace instructions documented.
